mapper.insert: insert into weaning_records (house_id, batch_id, breeding_cycle_id, rabbit_id, target_cage_id, in_cage_id, weaning_date, weaning_count, waiting_count, avg_weight, remark, create_by, update_by) values (#{houseId}, #{batchId}, #{breedingCycleId}, #{rabbitId}, #{targetCageId}, #{inCageId}, #{weaningDate}, #{weaningCount}, #{waitingCount}, #{avgWeight}, #{remark}, #{createBy}, #{updateBy})
mapper.select: select w.id, w.house_id, w.batch_id, w.breeding_cycle_id, w.rabbit_id, w.target_cage_id, ct.cage_number as target_cage_number, w.in_cage_id, ci.cage_number as in_cage_number, group_concat(concat(coalesce(ca.cage_number, concat('#',a.cage_id)), '×', a.alloc_count) order by a.cage_id separator ',') as alloc_summary, w.weaning_date, w.weaning_count, w.waiting_count, w.avg_weight, w.remark, w.create_by, w.create_time, w.update_by, w.update_time from weaning_records w inner join batches b on b.id = w.batch_id left join cages ct on ct.id = w.target_cage_id and ct.house_id = b.house_id left join cages ci on ci.id = w.in_cage_id and ci.house_id = b.house_id left join weaning_record_allocations a on a.weaning_record_id = w.id left join cages ca on ca.id = a.cage_id and ca.house_id = b.house_id where w.house_id = #{houseId} and b.house_id = #{houseId} and w.batch_id = #{batchId} group by w.id order by w.id desc limit #{limit}

select w.id, w.house_id, w.batch_id, w.breeding_cycle_id, w.rabbit_id, w.target_cage_id, ct.cage_number as target_cage_number, w.in_cage_id, ci.cage_number as in_cage_number, group_concat(concat(coalesce(ca.cage_number, concat('#',a.cage_id)), '×', a.alloc_count) order by a.cage_id separator ',') as alloc_summary, w.weaning_date, w.weaning_count, w.waiting_count, w.avg_weight, w.remark, w.create_by, w.create_time, w.update_by, w.update_time from weaning_records w inner join rabbits r on r.id = w.rabbit_id left join cages ct on ct.id = w.target_cage_id and ct.house_id = r.house_id left join cages ci on ci.id = w.in_cage_id and ci.house_id = r.house_id left join weaning_record_allocations a on a.weaning_record_id = w.id left join cages ca on ca.id = a.cage_id and ca.house_id = r.house_id where w.house_id = #{houseId} and r.house_id = #{houseId} and w.rabbit_id = #{rabbitId} group by w.id order by w.id desc limit #{limit}
